name: Nari
source:
A girl from the past who appears in flashbacks. Rhythm guitarist and best friend of Seraphina. Lives in the Old Quarter in a studio apartment.
A stylish “nonconformist” who suffers from deep self-doubt and considers herself “second fiddle” in her own life. She dreams of recognition, but is afraid to come out into the open.
